title: 森林学堂的南瓜手工课
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: identity for 皮皮 (pipi), preserve exactly: 暖灰毛、圆脸、粉色小鼻、自然下垂长耳；身份不随活动和换装变化。 Input 2: clothing only for 皮皮: 换装表左：灰蓝短背带裤、米色上衣、蓝布鞋、小黄书包，无帽；仅画这套服装，不复制表中其他兔子。 Input 3: identity for 团团 (tuantuan), preserve exactly: 暖棕圆脸、蓬松弯尾、奶油色胸前、小耳朵。 Input 4: identity for 山羊老师 (goat_teacher), preserve exactly: 奶油与浅灰毛、较长山羊口鼻、短圆弯角、侧垂耳、小胡须；成人体型与伙伴分开。
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi), 团团 (tuantuan), 山羊老师 (goat_teacher). Exact total number of visible characters: 3. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0, 团团 0.9, 山羊老师 1.65. Pipi wears ONLY the LEFT daytime outfit from the wardrobe sheet: dusty blue overalls, oatmeal shirt, blue cloth shoes, small yellow backpack. No star cap in daytime. Tuantuan wears the short dark ochre/rust scarf. The goat teacher wears the sage cardigan, oatmeal shirt and brown trousers. Scene continuity: 明亮木质教室的手工桌边，山羊老师带着皮皮和团团做秋日南瓜灯；三者身份比例清楚，桌上工具安全摆放。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 明亮木质教室的手工桌边，山羊老师带着皮皮和团团做秋日南瓜灯；三者身份比例清楚，桌上工具安全摆放。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 无画中文字或水印；只画剧本中在场角色，不新增来客；灯、蜡烛、南瓜外观及门廊方向保持连续。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events.
